The '''capture of ZA-13''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] at [[ZA-13]].

==Prelude==
After [[Attack on ZA-13|stopping]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] attempt to loot ''ZA-13''. [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was assigned to lead a new strike force to capture the plant. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had ordered that [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] production be a top military priority and ZA-13 was one of the few remaining plants that could be used to build more as many such as the [[Omar (Deep Space Manufacturing Facilities)|Omar]] facilities were [[Attack on Omar|destroyed]] by Zaarin.

==The battle==
The Imperial attack was again led by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who again led a group of 3 [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] into the area. Due to the fact that [[ZA-13]] was not entirely loyal to Zaarin, the factory did not need to be disabled. There were also no craft defending the station. Once the capture operation began, however, some [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] arrived, and began harassing Stele and his wingmen. Soon after the arrival of the Gunboats, [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] from [[Z-Caplure Group|''Caplure'' group]] arrived, to provide heavy fire support. As Stele's flight group had been armed with [[Proton rocket/Legends|proton rockets]], however, they proved no threat.

Once the Corvettes were dispatched, the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Z-Jumimi|Jumimi]]'' entered the battle zone. This was again not much of a threat to Stele and his colleagues, who were able to use their remaining rockets to lower its shields, before disabling it and finishing it off with lasers.

During the battle, several [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] arrived and fired rockets at [[ZA-13]]. They were supported by a small number of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]], making it tricky for the loyalists to destroy them without being eliminated themselves.

Throughout the battle, craft were docking with the factory to re-staff it, to supplement the staff onboard that had remained loyal to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Zaarin's forces harassed a number of the shuttles, meaning Stele had to keep an eye on both them and the capital ships attacking the factory.

After all of Zaarin's forces had been destroyed, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Render]]'' arrived to relieve the Defenders.

==Aftermath==
With the capture operation complete, ZA-13 was now under Imperial control and was to be upgraded and retrofitted to manufacture ''TIE Advanced''. a [[Convoy/Legends|Convoy]] designated [[Rope 17]] was to be deployed to bring the necessary materials and supplies, but was soon under [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Defense of ZA-13|attack]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''. It is Battle 8 Mission 3.
